data.summary: The review profile is highly suspicious. A contractor with 30 years in business has only 3 Google reviews. The positive reviews sound like solicited testimonials (one mentions the owner's 'booklet of references'), and the single negative review is vague. The complete absence of reviews on contractor-specific platforms (Angi, Houzz) and the BBB is a major red flag for a long-established business. This pattern suggests either a very new online presence or potential review manipulation.
fake_signals: Extremely low review volume for a 30-year business
Owner's 'booklet of references' mentioned in a review, suggesting solicitation
No reviews on any other platform (Angi, Houzz, etc.)
authentic_signals: Positive review mentions working on price
